title.raw: 《陳杞世家》 Houses of Chen and Qi

sentences.zh: 陳胡公滿者，虞帝舜之後也。

translations.literal: Chen Hu Gong Man was a descendant of Emperor Shun of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hu Gong, Man, was a descendant of Emperor Shun of Yu.

sentences.zh: 昔舜為庶人時，堯妻之二女，居于媯汭，其後因為氏姓，姓媯氏。

translations.literal: Formerly when Shun was a commoner, Yao married him two daughters, and they resided at Gui Rui. Their descendants therefore became the clan surname, the Gui clan.
translations.idiomatic: When Shun was still a commoner, Yao gave him his two daughters in marriage, and they lived at Gui Rui. Their descendants therefore took Gui as their clan surname.

sentences.zh: 舜已崩，傳禹天下，而舜子商均為封國。

translations.literal: Shun had already passed away and transmitted the world to Yu, while Shun's son Shang Jun was made an enfeoffed state.
translations.idiomatic: After Shun died and transmitted the realm to Yu, Shun's son Shang Jun was given a fief.

sentences.zh: 夏后之時，或失或續。

translations.literal: During the Xiahou time, some were lost and some continued.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xia rulers, some lines were lost and some continued.

sentences.zh: 至于周武王克殷紂，乃復求舜後，得媯滿，封之於陳，以奉帝舜祀，是為胡公。

translations.literal: When Zhou's King Wu conquered Yin Zhou, he then again sought Shun's descendants, obtained Gui Man, and enfeoffed him at Chen to continue Emperor Shun's sacrifices. This was Duke Hu.
translations.idiomatic: When King Wu of Zhou conquered King Zhou of Yin, he again sought out Shun's descendants, found Gui Man, and enfeoffed him at Chen to continue the sacrifices of Emperor Shun. This was Duke Hu.

sentences.zh: 胡公卒，子申公犀侯立。

translations.literal: Duke Hu died, and his son Duke Shen Xi Hou ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Hu was succeeded by his son, Duke Shen Xihou.

sentences.zh: 申公卒，弟相公皋羊立。

translations.literal: Duke Shen died, and his younger brother Duke Xiang Gao Yang ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Shen's younger brother, Duke Xiang Gaoyang, succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 相公卒，立申公子突，是為孝公。

translations.literal: Duke Xiang died, and they established Duke Shen's son Tu, who became Duke Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Xiang was followed by Duke Shen's son Tu, who became Duke Xiao.

sentences.zh: 孝公卒，子慎公圉戎立。

translations.literal: Duke Xiao died, and his son Duke Shen Yu Rong ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Xiao's son Duke Shen Yurong succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 慎公當周厲王時。

translations.literal: Duke Shen was during King Li of Zhou's time.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Shen lived during the time of King Li of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 慎公卒，子幽公寧立。

translations.literal: Duke Shen died, and his son Duke You Ning ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Shen's son Duke You Ning succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 幽公十二年，周厲王奔于彘。

translations.literal: In Duke You's twelfth year, King Li of Zhou fled to Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: In year twelve of Duke You, King Li of Zhou fled to Zhi.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，幽公卒，子釐公孝立。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Duke You died, and his son Duke Xi Xiao ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Duke You died, and his son Duke Xi Xiao succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 釐公六年，周宣王即位。

translations.literal: In Duke Xi's sixth year, King Xuan of Zhou ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Duke Xi's reign, King Xuan of Zhou ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，釐公卒，子武公靈立。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, Duke Xi died, and his son Duke Wu Ling ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, Duke Xi died, and his son Duke Wu Ling succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 武公十五年卒，子夷公說立。

translations.literal: Duke Wu died in his fifteenth year, and his son Duke Yi Yue ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Wu died in the fifteenth year of his reign, and his son Duke Yi Yue succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，周幽王即位。

translations.literal: In that year, King You of Zhou ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, King You of Zhou came to the throne.

sentences.zh: 夷公三年卒，弟平公燮立。

translations.literal: Duke Yi died in his third year, and his younger brother Duke Ping Xie ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Yi died in the third year of his reign, and his younger brother Duke Ping Xie succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 平公七年，周幽王為犬戎所殺，周東徙。

translations.literal: In Duke Ping's seventh year, King You of Zhou was killed by the Quan Rong, and Zhou moved east.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Duke Ping's reign, King You of Zhou was killed by the Quan Rong, and Zhou moved east.

sentences.zh: 秦始列為諸侯。

translations.literal: Qin began to be ranked as feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Qin was first ranked among the feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，平公卒，子文公圉立。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Duke Ping died, and his son Duke Wen Yu ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Duke Ping died, and his son Duke Wen Yu succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 文公元年，取蔡女，生子佗。

translations.literal: In Duke Wen's first year, he took a Cai woman and gave birth to a son named Tuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Duke Wen's reign, he married a Cai woman and had a son named Tuo.

sentences.zh: 十年，文公卒，長子桓公鮑立。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Duke Wen died, and his eldest son Duke Huan Bao ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Duke Wen died, and his eldest son Duke Huan Bao succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 桓公二十三年，魯隱公初立。

translations.literal: In Duke Huan's twenty-third year, Duke Yin of Lu first ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Duke Huan's reign, Duke Yin of Lu first ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，衛殺其君州吁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Wei assassinated their lord Zhou Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, the people of Wei killed their lord, Zhou Xu.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，魯弒其君隱公。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, Lu assassinated their lord Duke Yin.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, Lu killed its lord, Duke Yin.

sentences.zh: 三十八年正月甲戌己丑，桓公鮑卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, in the first month, from jiaxu to jichou, Duke Huan Bao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, in the first month, between the jiaxu and jichou days, Duke Huan Bao died.

sentences.zh: 桓公弟佗，其母蔡女，故蔡人為佗殺五父及桓公太子免而立佗，是為厲公。

translations.literal: Duke Huan's younger brother Tuo—his mother was a Cai woman, so the Cai people killed Wu Fu and Duke Huan's crown prince Mian on Tuo's behalf and established Tuo, who became Duke Li.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan's younger brother Tuo, whose mother was a Cai woman: the Cai people killed Wu Fu and Duke Huan's crown prince Mian on Tuo's behalf, then established Tuo, who became Duke Li.

sentences.zh: 桓公病而亂作，國人分散，故再赴。

translations.literal: Duke Huan was ill and chaos arose. The state people dispersed, so there was a double announcement.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan fell ill and chaos arose. The people scattered, so the death was announced twice.

sentences.zh: 厲公二年，生子敬仲完。

translations.literal: In Duke Li's second year, he gave birth to a son named Jing Zhong Wan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Duke Li's reign, he had a son named Jing Zhong Wan.

sentences.zh: 周太史過陳，陳厲公使以《周易》筮之，卦得觀之否：「是為觀國之光，利用賓于王。

translations.literal: The Grand Scribe of Zhou passed through Chen, and Duke Li of Chen had him divine with the Zhou Yi. The hexagram obtained was Guan changing to Pi: 'This is to observe the light of the state; it is beneficial to be a guest at the king's court.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Scribe of Zhou passed through Chen, and Duke Li of Chen had him divine using the Zhou Yi. The hexagram obtained was Guan changing to Pi: 'This is to observe the light of the state; it is beneficial to be a guest at the king's court.

sentences.zh: 此其代陳有國乎？

translations.literal: Will he replace Chen and possess a state?
translations.idiomatic: Will he take Chen’s place and possess a state?

sentences.zh: 不在此，其在異國？

translations.literal: Not here, perhaps in different country?
translations.idiomatic: Not here, but perhaps in a different country?

sentences.zh: 非此其身，在其子孫。

translations.literal: Not this person himself, but in his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Not in this person himself, but in his descendants.

sentences.zh: 若在異國，必姜姓。

translations.literal: If in a different state, it must be the Jiang clan.
translations.idiomatic: If in another state, it must be the Jiang clan.

sentences.zh: 姜姓，太嶽之後。

translations.literal: The Jiang surname are descendants of Tai Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Those of the Jiang surname are descendants of Tai Yue.

sentences.zh: 物莫能兩大，陳衰，此其昌乎？」

translations.literal: Things cannot two great, Chen declines, this will prosper?'
translations.idiomatic: Things cannot have two great ones. When Chen declines, will this prosper?'

sentences.zh: 厲公取蔡女，蔡女與蔡人亂，厲公數如蔡淫。

translations.literal: Duke Li took a Cai woman, but the Cai woman had illicit relations with Cai people. Duke Li frequently went to Cai to be licentious.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Li married a Cai woman, but the Cai woman had illicit relations with Cai people. Duke Li frequently went to Cai to be licentious.

sentences.zh: 七年，厲公所殺桓公太子免之三弟，長曰躍，中曰林，少曰杵臼，共令蔡人誘厲公以好女，與蔡人共殺厲公而立躍，是為利公。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the three younger brothers of the Huan Gong crown prince Mian whom Li Gong had killed—the eldest named Yue, the middle named Lin, the youngest named Chu Jiu—together commanded the Cai people to lure Duke Li with beautiful women, and together with the Cai people killed Duke Li and established Yue, who became Duke Li.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, the three younger brothers of Crown Prince Mian of Duke Huan, whom Duke Li had killed—the eldest named Yue, the middle named Lin, the youngest named Chu Jiu—together commanded the Cai people to lure Duke Li with beautiful women, and together with the Cai people killed Duke Li and established Yue, who became Duke Li.

sentences.zh: 利公者，桓公子也。

translations.literal: Duke Li was Duke Huan's son.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Li was Duke Huan's son.

sentences.zh: 利公立五月卒，立中弟林，是為莊公。

translations.literal: Duke Li ascended for five months and died. They established his middle younger brother Lin, who became Duke Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Li reigned for five months and died. They established his middle brother Lin, who became Duke Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 莊公七年卒，少弟杵臼立，是為宣公。

translations.literal: Duke Zhuang died in his seventh year. His youngest younger brother Chu Jiu ascended, who became Duke Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Zhuang died in the seventh year of his reign. His youngest brother, Chu Jiu, succeeded him, becoming Duke Xuan.

sentences.zh: 宣公三年，楚武王卒，楚始彊。

translations.literal: In Duke Xuan's third year, King Wu of Chu died, and Chu began to grow strong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Duke Xuan's reign, King Wu of Chu died, and Chu began to grow strong.

sentences.zh: 十七年，周惠王娶陳女為后。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, King Hui of Zhou married a Chen woman as his queen.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, King Hui of Zhou took a woman of Chen as his queen.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，宣公後有嬖姬生子款，欲立之，乃殺其太子御寇。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Duke Xuan later had a favored concubine who bore a son named Kuan. He wished to establish him as heir, so he killed his crown prince Yu Kou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, Duke Xuan later took a favored concubine who bore a son named Kuan. Wishing to establish him as heir, he killed his crown prince Yu Kou.

sentences.zh: 御寇素愛厲公子完，完懼禍及己，乃奔齊。

translations.literal: Yu Kou usually loved Duke Li's son Wan. Wan feared calamity would reach himself, so he fled to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Kou had always loved Duke Li's son Wan. Wan feared that calamity would reach him, so he fled to the state of Qi.

sentences.zh: 齊桓公欲使陳完為卿，完曰：「羈旅之臣，幸得免負檐，君之惠也，不敢當高位。」

translations.literal: Duke Huan of Qi wished to make Chen Wan a minister. Wan said: 'A sojourning subject is fortunate to be spared carrying loads on his back—this is my lord's grace; I dare not accept a high position.'
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan of Qi wished to appoint Chen Wan as a minister, but Wan said: 'A wandering exile like myself is fortunate enough simply to be spared the burden of a refugee's life—such is my lord's grace. I dare not presume to accept so high a position.'

sentences.zh: 桓公使為工正。

translations.literal: Duke Huan made him Gong Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan made him Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 齊懿仲欲妻陳敬仲，卜之，占曰：「是謂鳳皇于飛，和鳴鏘鏘。

translations.literal: Qi Yi Zhong desired marry Chen Jing Zhong, divined it, omen said: 'This called phoenix in flight, harmonious cry clang clang.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Zhong of Qi desired to marry his daughter to Chen Jing Zhong. He divined it, and the omen said: 'This is called phoenixes in flight, harmoniously calling with clanging sounds.

sentences.zh: 有媯之後，將育于姜。

translations.literal: Have Gui descendants, will be nourished at Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: The descendants of Gui will be nourished among the Jiang.

sentences.zh: 五世其昌，并于正卿。

translations.literal: Five generations will prosper, equal to the proper ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In five generations they will prosper, equal to the proper ministers.

sentences.zh: 八世之後，莫之與京。」

translations.literal: Eight generations after, none rival with Jing.'
translations.idiomatic: After eight generations, none will rival them.'

sentences.zh: 三十七年，齊桓公伐蔡，蔡敗；

translations.literal: Thirty-seventh year, Qi Huan Gong attacked Cai, Cai defeated;
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year, Duke Huan of Qi attacked Cai, and Cai was defeated;

sentences.zh: 南侵楚，至召陵，還過陳。

translations.literal: He invaded south against Chu, reached Shao Ling, and on his return passed through Chen.
translations.idiomatic: He marched south against Chu, reached Shaoling, and passed through Chen on his return.

sentences.zh: 陳大夫轅濤涂惡其過陳，詐齊令出東道。

translations.literal: Chen's grand officer Yuan Taotu disliked his passing through Chen and tricked Qi into sending them out by the eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: The Chen grand officer Yuan Taotu disliked Qi's passage through Chen, so he tricked Qi into leaving by the eastern route.

sentences.zh: 東道惡，桓公怒，執陳轅濤涂。

translations.literal: The eastern route was poor. Duke Huan was angered and seized Yuan Taotu of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern route was poor, and Duke Huan was angered, so he seized Yuan Taotu of Chen.

sentences.zh: 是歲，晉獻公殺其太子申生。

translations.literal: In this year, Duke Xian of Jin killed his crown prince Shen Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Duke Xian of Jin killed his crown prince, Shen Sheng.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，宣公卒，子款立，是為穆公。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year, Duke Xuan died, and his son Kuan ascended, who became Duke Mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year, Duke Xuan died, and his son Kuan succeeded him, becoming Duke Mu.

sentences.zh: 穆公五年，齊桓公卒。

translations.literal: In Duke Mu's fifth year, Duke Huan of Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Duke Mu's reign, Duke Huan of Qi died.

sentences.zh: 十六年，晉文公敗楚師于城濮。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Duke Wen of Jin defeated Chu troops at Cheng Pu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, Duke Wen of Jin defeated the Chu army at Chengpu.

sentences.zh: 是歲，穆公卒，子共公朔立。

translations.literal: In this year, Duke Mu died, and his son Duke Gong Shuo ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In this year, Duke Mu died, and his son Duke Gong Shuo succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 共公六年，楚太子商臣弒其父成王代立，是為穆王。

translations.literal: In Duke Gong's sixth year, Chu's Crown Prince Shang Chen assassinated his father King Cheng and replaced him, becoming King Mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Duke Gong's reign, Chu's Crown Prince Shang Chen assassinated his father King Cheng and replaced him, becoming King Mu.

sentences.zh: 十一年，秦穆公卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Duke Mu of Qin died.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Mu of Qin died in the eleventh year.

sentences.zh: 十八年，共公卒，子靈公平國立。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Duke Gong died, and his son Duke Ling Ping Guo ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, Duke Gong died, and his son Duke Ling Ping Guo succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 靈公元年，楚莊王即位。

translations.literal: In Duke Ling's first year, King Zhuang of Chu ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Duke Ling's reign, King Zhuang of Chu ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 六年，楚伐陳。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Chu attacked Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Chu attacked Chen.

sentences.zh: 十年，陳及楚平。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Chen and Chu made peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Chen made peace with Chu.

sentences.zh: 十四年，靈公與其大夫孔寧、儀行父皆通於夏姬，衷其衣以戲於朝。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Duke Ling and his grand officers Kong Ning and Yi Xing Fu all had relations with Xia Ji. They wore her undergarments inside out for sport in court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Duke Ling and his grand officers Kong Ning and Yi Xingfu all had relations with Xia Ji. They wore her undergarments beneath their robes and made sport of it at court.

sentences.zh: 泄冶諫曰：「君臣淫亂，民何效焉？」

translations.literal: Xie Ye remonstrated, saying: 'When lord and ministers are licentious and disorderly, what will the people imitate?'
translations.idiomatic: Xie Ye remonstrated, saying, “If lord and ministers are licentious and disorderly, what will the people imitate?”

sentences.zh: 靈公以告二子，二子請殺泄冶，公弗禁，遂殺泄冶。

translations.literal: Duke Ling told the two men. The two men requested permission to kill Xie Ye. The duke did not forbid it, so they killed Xie Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Ling told the two men. The two men requested to kill Xie Ye. The duke did not forbid it, so they killed Xie Ye.

sentences.zh: 十五年，靈公與二子飲於夏氏。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Duke Ling drank with his two sons at the Xia clan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Duke Ling drank with the two men at the Xia clan.

sentences.zh: 公戲二子曰：「徵舒似汝。」

translations.literal: The duke teased the two men, saying: 'Xia Zheng Shu resembles you.'
translations.idiomatic: The duke teased the two men, saying, “Xia Zhengshu resembles you.”

sentences.zh: 二子曰：「亦似公。」

translations.literal: Two sons said: 'Also resembles gong.'
translations.idiomatic: The two men said: 'He also resembles you, my lord.'

sentences.zh: 徵舒怒。

translations.literal: Xia Zheng Shu was angered.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Zheng Shu was angered.

sentences.zh: 靈公罷酒出，徵舒伏弩廏門射殺靈公。

translations.literal: Duke Ling stopped drinking and went out. Xia Zheng Shu hid a crossbow at the stable gate and shot Duke Ling to death.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Ling stopped drinking and went out. Xia Zhengshu hid a crossbow at the stable gate and shot him dead.

sentences.zh: 孔寧、儀行父皆奔楚，靈公太子午奔晉。

translations.literal: Kong Ning and Yi Xing Fu all fled to Chu. Duke Ling's crown prince Wu fled to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Ning and Yi Xing Fu all fled to Chu. The crown prince Wu of Duke Ling fled to Jin.

sentences.zh: 徵舒自立為陳侯。

translations.literal: Xia Zheng Shu established himself as Duke of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Zhengshu then set himself up as Duke of Chen.

sentences.zh: 徵舒，故陳大夫也。

translations.literal: Xia Zheng Shu was formerly a grand officer of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Zhengshu had formerly been a grand officer of Chen.

sentences.zh: 夏姬，御叔之妻，舒之母也。

translations.literal: Xia Ji, Yu Shu's wife, Shu's mother.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Ji was Yu Shu's wife and Shu's mother.

sentences.zh: 成公元年冬，楚莊王為夏徵舒殺靈公，率諸侯伐陳。

translations.literal: In Duke Cheng's first year winter, King Zhuang of Chu, because Xia Zheng Shu killed Duke Ling, led the feudal lords to attack Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the first year of Duke Cheng's reign, King Zhuang of Chu, because Xia Zheng Shu had killed Duke Ling, led the feudal lords to attack Chen.

sentences.zh: 謂陳曰：「無驚，吾誅徵舒而已。」

translations.literal: He told Chen, saying: 'Do not be alarmed; I will execute Xia Zheng Shu only.'
translations.idiomatic: He told the people of Chen, 'Do not be alarmed; I will execute only Xia Zheng Shu.'

sentences.zh: 已誅徵舒，因縣陳而有之，群臣畢賀。

translations.literal: Having executed Xia Zheng Shu, he therefore suspended Chen and possessed it. All the ministers congratulated him.
translations.idiomatic: Having executed Xia Zheng Shu, he therefore made Chen a county and took possession of it. All the ministers congratulated him.

sentences.zh: 申叔時使於齊來還，獨不賀。

translations.literal: Shen Shu Shi, who was envoy to Qi, came back and alone did not congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Shu Shi, who had been envoy to Qi, came back and alone did not congratulate.

sentences.zh: 莊王問其故，對曰：「鄙語有之，牽牛徑人田，田主奪之牛。

translations.literal: King Zhuang asked the reason. He replied, saying: 'There is a vulgar saying: if one leads an ox to cut across another man's field, the field owner seizes the ox.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhuang asked the reason. He replied, 'There is a common saying: if one leads an ox across another man's field, the field owner seizes the ox.

sentences.zh: 徑則有罪矣，奪之牛，不亦甚乎？

translations.literal: Trespassing then has guilt, seizing the ox, not also excessive?
translations.idiomatic: Trespassing is indeed a crime, but is seizing the ox not excessive?

sentences.zh: 今王以徵舒為賊弒君，故徵兵諸侯，以義伐之，已而取之，以利其地，則後何以令於天下！

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty, because Xia Zheng Shu was a traitor who assassinated his lord, summoned the feudal lords' troops and attacked in righteousness; but having done so, you then took possession to profit from its land—how then can you issue commands to all under Heaven hereafter!
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty summoned the armies of the feudal lords and attacked in righteousness because Xia Zheng Shu was a traitor who assassinated his lord. Yet after doing so, you took possession of Chen to profit from its land. How, then, can you issue commands to the realm hereafter?

sentences.zh: 是以不賀。」

translations.literal: That is why I did not congratulate.'
translations.idiomatic: That is why I did not congratulate.'

sentences.zh: 莊王曰：「善。」

translations.literal: Zhuang Wang said: 'Good.'
translations.idiomatic: King Zhuang said: 'Good.'

sentences.zh: 乃迎陳靈公太子午於晉而立之，復君陳如故，是為成公。

translations.literal: He then welcomed Chen's Duke Ling's crown prince Wu from Jin and established him, again ruling Chen as before. This was Duke Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: He then welcomed Crown Prince Wu, the son of Duke Ling of Chen, back from Jin and installed him, restoring Chen's ruler as before. This was Duke Cheng.

sentences.zh: 孔子讀史記至楚復陳，曰：「賢哉楚莊王！

translations.literal: Confucius read the historical records to the passage where Chu restored Chen, and said: 'How worthy indeed was King Zhuang of Chu!
translations.idiomatic: When Confucius read in the historical records to the passage where Chu restored Chen, he said, “How worthy King Zhuang of Chu was!

sentences.zh: 輕千乘之國而重一言。」

translations.literal: Light thousand chariot state but heavy one word.'
translations.idiomatic: He treated lightly a state of a thousand chariots but valued a single word.'

sentences.zh: ［二十］八年，楚莊王卒。

translations.literal: [Twenty] eighth year, Chu Zhuang Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, King Zhuang of Chu died.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，陳倍楚盟。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Chen doubled-crossed the Chu alliance.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, Chen betrayed the Chu alliance.

sentences.zh: 三十年，楚共王伐陳。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, King Gong of Chu attacked Chen.
translations.idiomatic: King Gong of Chu attacked Chen in the thirtieth year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，成公卒，子哀公弱立。

translations.literal: In this year, Duke Cheng died, and his son Duke Ai Ruo ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In this year, Duke Cheng died, and his son Duke Ai Ruo succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 楚以陳喪，罷兵去。

translations.literal: Chu, because of Chen's mourning, stopped the troops and left.
translations.idiomatic: Because Chen was in mourning, Chu halted the campaign and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 哀公三年，楚圍陳，復釋之。

translations.literal: In Duke Ai's third year, Chu surrounded Chen, then freed it again.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Duke Ai's reign, Chu surrounded Chen, then freed it again.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，楚公子圍弒其君郟敖自立，為靈王。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Chu's Prince Wei assassinated his lord Jia Ao and self-established, becoming King Ling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, Chu's Prince Wei assassinated his lord Jia Ao and established himself, becoming King Ling.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，初，哀公娶鄭，長姬生悼太子師，少姬生偃。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, initially Duke Ai married a woman from Zheng. His elder wife gave birth to Crown Prince Dao Shi, his younger wife gave birth to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year, initially Duke Ai married a woman from Zheng. His elder wife gave birth to Crown Prince Dao Shi, and his younger wife gave birth to Yan.

sentences.zh: 二嬖妾，長妾生留，少妾生勝。

translations.literal: Two favored concubines: the elder concubine gave birth to Liu, the younger concubine gave birth to Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: He had two favored concubines: the elder concubine gave birth to Liu, and the younger concubine gave birth to Sheng.

sentences.zh: 留有寵哀公，哀公屬之其弟司徒招。

translations.literal: Liu was favored by Duke Ai. Duke Ai entrusted him to his younger brother Situ Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Liu was favored by Duke Ai. Duke Ai entrusted him to his younger brother, Steward Zhao.

sentences.zh: 哀公病，三月，招殺悼太子，立留為太子。

translations.literal: Duke Ai was ill. In the third month, Zhao killed the Dao crown prince and established Liu as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Ai was ill. In the third month, Zhao killed Crown Prince Dao and established Liu as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 哀公怒，欲誅招，招發兵圍守哀公，哀公自經殺。

translations.literal: Duke Ai was angered and desired to execute Zhao. Zhao raised troops and surrounded Duke Ai. Duke Ai hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Ai was angered and wanted to execute Zhao. Zhao raised troops and surrounded Duke Ai, and Duke Ai hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 招卒立留為陳君。

translations.literal: Zhao finally established Liu as lord of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao at last set up Liu as lord of Chen.

sentences.zh: 四月，陳使使赴楚。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Chen sent an envoy to Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Chen dispatched an envoy to Chu.

sentences.zh: 楚靈王聞陳亂，乃殺陳使者，使公子棄疾發兵伐陳，陳君留奔鄭。

translations.literal: King Ling of Chu heard of Chen's chaos and killed the Chen envoy. He had Prince Qi Ji raise troops to attack Chen. Chen's lord Liu fled to Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: When King Ling of Chu heard of Chen’s disorder, he killed the Chen envoy and ordered Prince Qiji to raise troops against Chen. Liu, the lord of Chen, fled to Zheng.

sentences.zh: 九月，楚圍陳。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Chu surrounded Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Chu surrounded Chen.

sentences.zh: 十一月，滅陳。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, they extinguished Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Chu destroyed Chen.

sentences.zh: 使棄疾為陳公。

translations.literal: They made Qi Ji the Duke of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Chu made Qi Ji the Duke of Chen.

sentences.zh: 招之殺悼太子也，太子之子名吳，出奔晉。

translations.literal: Zhao what killed Dao crown prince, crown prince's son named Wu, fled Jin.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao killed Crown Prince Dao, the crown prince's son named Wu fled to Jin.

sentences.zh: 晉平公問太史趙曰：「陳遂亡乎？」

translations.literal: Duke Ping of Jin asked the Grand Scribe Zhao, saying: 'Has Chen finally perished?'
translations.idiomatic: Duke Ping of Jin asked Grand Scribe Zhao, “Has Chen finally perished?”

sentences.zh: 對曰：「陳，顓頊之族。

translations.literal: He replied, saying: 'Chen is of the clan of Zhuanxu.
translations.idiomatic: He replied, 'Chen is of the clan of Zhuanxu.

sentences.zh: 陳氏得政於齊，乃卒亡。

translations.literal: When the Chen clan obtains power in Qi, Chen will finally perish.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chen clan obtains power in Qi, the state of Chen will finally perish.

sentences.zh: 自幕至于瞽瞍，無違命。

translations.literal: From Mu until Gu Sou, none violated commands.
translations.idiomatic: From Mu down to Gu Sou, none disobeyed commands.

sentences.zh: 舜重之以明德。

translations.literal: Shun reinforced them with bright virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Shun reinforced them with bright virtue.

sentences.zh: 至於遂，世世守之。

translations.literal: They arrived at Sui and guarded it generation after generation.
translations.idiomatic: They reached Sui and guarded it from generation to generation.

sentences.zh: 及胡公，周賜之姓，使祀虞帝。

translations.literal: When it came to Duke Hu, Zhou granted the clan a surname and had them sacrifice to Emperor Shun of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: When the line reached Duke Hu, Zhou granted the clan a surname and had them offer sacrifices to Emperor Shun of Yu.

sentences.zh: 且盛德之後，必百世祀。

translations.literal: Moreover, descendants of flourishing virtue must sacrifice for a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, descendants of flourishing virtue must maintain sacrifices for a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 虞之世未也，其在齊乎？」

translations.literal: The line of Yu has not ended; perhaps it is in Qi?'
translations.idiomatic: The line of Yu has not ended; perhaps it survives in Qi?”

sentences.zh: 楚靈王滅陳五歲，楚公子棄疾弒靈王代立，是為平王。

translations.literal: Five years after King Ling of Chu extinguished Chen, Chu's Prince Qi Ji assassinated King Ling and replaced him, becoming King Ping.
translations.idiomatic: Five years after King Ling of Chu destroyed Chen, the Chu prince Qi Ji assassinated King Ling and replaced him, becoming King Ping.

sentences.zh: 平王初立，欲得和諸侯，乃求故陳悼太子師之子吳，立為陳侯，是為惠公。

translations.literal: Ping Wang first ascended, desired obtain harmony feudal lords, then sought former Chen Dao crown prince Shi's son Wu, established as Chen Hou, this was Hui Gong.
translations.idiomatic: When King Ping had just ascended, he wished to restore harmony among the feudal lords, so he sought out Wu, the son of the former Crown Prince Shi of Duke Dao of Chen, and established him as lord of Chen. This was Duke Hui.

sentences.zh: 惠公立，探續哀公卒時年而為元，空籍五歲矣。

translations.literal: Duke Hui ascended. He investigated and continued from Duke Ai's death year as the yuan year. The register was empty for five years.
translations.idiomatic: After Duke Hui took the throne, he retroactively counted from the year of Duke Ai's death as his first year, leaving a five-year gap in the register.

sentences.zh: 十年，陳火。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Chen had a fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Chen suffered a fire.

sentences.zh: 十五年，吳王僚使公子光伐陳，取胡、沈而去。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, King Liao of Wu had Prince Guang attack Chen, took Hu and Shen, and left.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, King Liao of Wu sent Prince Guang to attack Chen; he took Hu and Shen and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，吳王闔閭與子胥敗楚入郢。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, King He Lu of Wu with Zi Xu defeated Chu and entered Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, King Helu of Wu together with Zixu defeated Chu and entered Ying.

sentences.zh: 是年，惠公卒，子懷公柳立。

translations.literal: In this year, Duke Hui died, and his son Duke Huai Liu ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In this year, Duke Hui died, and his son Duke Huai Liu succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 懷公元年，吳破楚，在郢，召陳侯。

translations.literal: In Duke Huai's first year, Wu broke Chu and was at Ying, summoning the Chen hou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Duke Huai's reign, Wu broke Chu and was at Ying, summoning the lord of Chen.

sentences.zh: 陳侯欲往，大夫曰：「吳新得意；

translations.literal: Chen Hou desired go, grand officers said: 'Wu newly obtained delight;
translations.idiomatic: The lord of Chen desired to go, but the grandees said: 'Wu has just won a victory;

sentences.zh: 楚王雖亡，與陳有故，不可倍。」

translations.literal: Chu wang though perished, with Chen has old relations, cannot double-cross.'
translations.idiomatic: Though the king of Chu has perished, we have old relations with Chu and cannot betray them.'

sentences.zh: 懷公乃以疾謝吳。

translations.literal: Duke Huai then declined Wu with illness.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huai then declined Wu on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 四年，吳復召懷公。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Wu again summoned Duke Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Wu summoned Duke Huai once more.

sentences.zh: 懷公恐，如吳。

translations.literal: Duke Huai feared and went to Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huai feared and went to Wu.

sentences.zh: 吳怒其前不往，留之，因卒吳。

translations.literal: Wu was angered by his previous not going and detained him. He therefore died in Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Wu was angered because he had not come before and detained him. He therefore died in Wu.

sentences.zh: 陳乃立懷公之子越，是為湣公。

translations.literal: Chen then established Huai Gong's son Yue, this was Min Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Chen then established Duke Huai's son Yue, who became Duke Min.

sentences.zh: 湣公六年，孔子適陳。

translations.literal: In Duke Min's sixth year, Kong Qiu went to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Duke Min's reign, Confucius went to Chen.

sentences.zh: 吳王夫差伐陳，取三邑而去。

translations.literal: King Fu Cha of Wu attacked Chen, took three cities, and left.
translations.idiomatic: King Fuchai of Wu attacked Chen, took three cities, and left.

sentences.zh: 十三年，吳復來伐陳，陳告急楚，楚昭王來救，軍於城父，吳師去。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Wu again came to attack Chen. Chen reported urgently to Chu. King Zhao of Chu came to save them and stationed at Cheng Fu. The Wu troops left.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Wu again attacked Chen. Chen urgently appealed to Chu, and King Zhao of Chu came to its rescue, stationing his army at Chengfu. The Wu troops withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是年，楚昭王卒於城父。

translations.literal: In this year, King Zhao of Chu died at Cheng Fu.
translations.idiomatic: That year, King Zhao of Chu died at Chengfu.

sentences.zh: 時孔子在陳。

translations.literal: At that time, Kong Qiu was in Chen.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, Confucius was in Chen.

sentences.zh: 十五年，宋滅曹。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Song extinguished Cao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Song destroyed Cao.

sentences.zh: 十六年，吳王夫差伐齊，敗之艾陵，使人召陳侯。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, King Fu Cha of Wu attacked Qi, defeated them at Ai Ling, and had people summon the Chen hou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, King Fuchai of Wu attacked Qi, defeated them at Ai Ling, and had people summon the lord of Chen.

sentences.zh: 陳侯恐，如吳。

translations.literal: The Chen hou feared and went to Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The lord of Chen feared and went to Wu.

sentences.zh: 楚伐陳。

translations.literal: Chu attacked Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Chu attacked Chen.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，齊田常弒其君簡公。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Qi's Tian Chang assassinated their lord Duke Jian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, Tian Chang of Qi assassinated their lord Duke Jian.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，楚之白公勝殺令尹子西、子綦，襲惠王。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Bai Gong Sheng of Chu killed the prime ministers Zixi and Ziqi and attacked King Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Bai Gong Sheng of Chu killed the prime ministers Zixi and Ziqi, then attacked King Hui.

sentences.zh: 葉公攻敗白公，白公自殺。

translations.literal: Duke Ye attacked and defeated Bai Gong. Bai Gong committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Ye attacked and defeated Bai Gong, who then killed himself.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，楚惠王復國，以兵北伐，殺陳湣公，遂滅陳而有之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, King Hui of Chu recovered his state and with troops attacked north, killed Duke Min of Chen, then extinguished Chen and possessed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, King Hui of Chu recovered his state and with troops attacked north, killed Duke Min of Chen, then destroyed Chen and took possession of it.

sentences.zh: 是歲，孔子卒。

translations.literal: In this year, Kong Qiu died.
translations.idiomatic: In this year, Confucius died.

sentences.zh: 杞東樓公者，夏后禹之後苗裔也。

translations.literal: Qi Dong Lou Gong was Xiahou Yu's descendants posterity.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Dong Lou Gong was a descendant of Yu of the Xia rulers.

sentences.zh: 殷時或封或絕。

translations.literal: During Yin times, they were sometimes enfeoffed and sometimes ended.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yin times, they were sometimes enfeoffed and sometimes ended.

sentences.zh: 周武王克殷紂，求禹之後，得東樓公，封之於杞，以奉夏后氏祀。

translations.literal: Zhou's King Wu conquered Yin Zhou and sought Yu's descendants. He obtained Duke Dong Lou and enfeoffed him at Qi to continue the Xiahou clan's sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: King Wu of Zhou conquered Yin Zhou and sought Yu's descendants. He obtained Duke Dong Lou and enfeoffed him at Qi to continue the Xiahou clan's sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 東樓公生西樓公，西樓公生題公，題公生謀娶公。

translations.literal: Duke Dong Lou gave birth to Duke Xi Lou. Duke Xi Lou gave birth to Duke Ti. Duke Ti gave birth to Duke Mou Qu.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Dong Lou begot Duke Xi Lou; Duke Xi Lou begot Duke Ti; and Duke Ti begot Duke Mou Qu.

sentences.zh: 謀娶公當周厲王時。

translations.literal: Duke Mou Qu was during King Li of Zhou's time.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Mou Qu lived during the time of King Li of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 謀娶公生武公。

translations.literal: Duke Mou Qu gave birth to Duke Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Mou Qu had a son, Duke Wu.

sentences.zh: 武公立四十七年卒，子靖公立。

translations.literal: Duke Wu ascended for forty-seven years and died. His son Duke Jing ascended.
translations.idiomatic: After a reign of forty-seven years, Duke Wu died and was succeeded by his son Duke Jing.

sentences.zh: 靖公二十三年卒，子共公立。

translations.literal: Duke Jing died in his twenty-third year. His son Duke Gong ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Jing died in his twenty-third year, and his son Duke Gong succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 共公八年卒，子德公立。

translations.literal: Duke Gong died in his eighth year. His son Duke De ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In his eighth year, Duke Gong died and was succeeded by his son Duke De.

sentences.zh: 德公十八年卒，弟桓公姑容立。

translations.literal: Duke De died in his eighteenth year. His younger brother Duke Huan Gu Rong ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke De died in his eighteenth year, and his younger brother Duke Huan Gu Rong succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 桓公十七年卒，子孝公丐立。

translations.literal: Duke Huan died in his seventeenth year. His son Duke Xiao Gai ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In his seventeenth year, Duke Huan died and was succeeded by his son Duke Xiao Gai.

sentences.zh: 孝公十七年卒，弟文公益姑立。

translations.literal: Duke Xiao died in his seventeenth year. His younger brother Duke Wen Yi Gu ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Xiao died in his seventeenth year, and his younger brother Duke Wen Yi Gu succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 文公十四年卒，弟平公郁立。

translations.literal: Duke Wen died in his fourteenth year. His younger brother Duke Ping Yu ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In his fourteenth year, Duke Wen died and was succeeded by his younger brother Duke Ping Yu.

sentences.zh: 平公十八年卒，子悼公成立。

translations.literal: Duke Ping died in his eighteenth year. His son Duke Dao Cheng Li ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Ping died in his eighteenth year, and his son Duke Dao Cheng succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 悼公十二年卒，子隱公乞立。

translations.literal: Duke Dao died in his twelfth year. His son Duke Yin Qi ascended.
translations.idiomatic: In his twelfth year, Duke Dao died and was succeeded by his son Duke Yin Qi.

sentences.zh: 七月，隱公弟遂弒隱公自立，是為釐公。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Duke Yin's younger brother Sui assassinated Duke Yin and self-established, becoming Duke Xi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Duke Yin's younger brother Sui assassinated Duke Yin and established himself, becoming Duke Xi.

sentences.zh: 釐公十九年卒，子湣公維立。

translations.literal: Duke Xi died in his nineteenth year. His son Duke Min Wei ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Xi died in his nineteenth year, and his son Duke Min Wei succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 湣公十五年，楚惠王滅陳。

translations.literal: In Duke Min's fifteenth year, King Hui of Chu extinguished Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Duke Min's reign, King Hui of Chu destroyed Chen.

sentences.zh: 十六年，湣公弟閼路弒湣公代立，是為哀公。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Duke Min's younger brother Yan Lu assassinated Duke Min and replaced him, becoming Duke Ai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, Duke Min’s younger brother Yan Lu killed Duke Min and took his place. This was Duke Ai.

sentences.zh: 哀公立十年卒，湣公子敕立，是為出公。

translations.literal: Duke Ai ascended for ten years and died. Duke Min's son Chi was established, becoming Duke Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Ai reigned for ten years and died. Duke Min's son Chi was established, becoming Duke Chu.

sentences.zh: 出公十二年卒，子簡公春立。

translations.literal: Duke Chu died in his twelfth year. His son Duke Jian Chun ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Chu died in his twelfth year, and his son Duke Jian Chun succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 立一年，楚惠王之四十四年，滅杞。

translations.literal: He ascended for one year. In King Hui of Chu's forty-fourth year, they extinguished Qi.
translations.idiomatic: He reigned for one year. In the forty-fourth year of King Hui of Chu's reign, they destroyed Qi.

sentences.zh: 杞後陳亡三十四年。

translations.literal: Qi perished thirty-four years after Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Qi perished thirty-four years after Chen.

sentences.zh: 杞小微，其事不足稱述。

translations.literal: Qi was small and tiny. Its affairs are insufficient to praise and narrate.
translations.idiomatic: Qi was small and weak. Its affairs are too slight to praise or narrate at length.

sentences.zh: 舜之後，周武王封之陳，至楚惠王滅之，有世家言。

translations.literal: Shun's descendants—Zhou's King Wu enfeoffed them at Chen, until King Hui of Chu extinguished them. There are hereditary houses that speak of this.
translations.idiomatic: Shun's descendants were enfeoffed by King Wu of Zhou in the state of Chen, until King Hui of Chu destroyed them. Their story is told in the hereditary houses.

sentences.zh: 禹之後，周武王封之杞，楚惠王滅之，有世家言。

translations.literal: Yu's descendants—Zhou's King Wu enfeoffed them at Qi, until King Hui of Chu extinguished them. There are hereditary houses that speak of this.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's descendants were enfeoffed by King Wu of Zhou in the state of Qi, until King Hui of Chu destroyed them. Their story is told in the hereditary houses.

sentences.zh: 契之後為殷，殷有本紀言。

translations.literal: Qi's descendants became Yin. Yin has basic annals that speak of this.
translations.idiomatic: Xie's descendants became Yin. Yin has basic annals that speak of this.

sentences.zh: 殷破，周封其後於宋，齊湣王滅之，有世家言。

translations.literal: Yin was broken. Zhou enfeoffed their descendants at Song. Duke Min of Qi extinguished them. There are hereditary houses that speak of this.
translations.idiomatic: When Yin fell, Zhou enfeoffed its descendants in the state of Song. King Min of Qi destroyed them. Their story is told in the hereditary houses.

sentences.zh: 后稷之後為周，秦昭王滅之，有本紀言。

translations.literal: Hou Ji's descendants became Zhou. King Zhao of Qin extinguished them. There are basic annals that speak of this.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Ji's descendants became the state of Zhou. King Zhao of Qin destroyed them. Their story is told in the basic annals.

sentences.zh: 皋陶之後，或封英、六，楚穆王滅之，無譜。

translations.literal: Gao Yao's descendants were sometimes enfeoffed at Ying and Liu. King Mu of Chu extinguished them. There is no genealogy.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yao's descendants were sometimes enfeoffed at the states of Ying and Liu. King Mu of Chu destroyed them. There is no genealogy.

sentences.zh: 伯夷之後，至周武王復封於齊，曰太公望，陳氏滅之，有世家言。

translations.literal: Bo Yi's descendants were again enfeoffed at Qi by Zhou's King Wu, called Tai Gong Wang. The Chen clan extinguished them. There are hereditary houses that speak of this.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Yi's descendants were again enfeoffed at Qi by King Wu of Zhou, under the name Tai Gong Wang. The Chen clan destroyed them. Their story is told in the hereditary houses.

sentences.zh: 伯翳之後，至周平王時封為秦，項羽滅之，有本紀言。

translations.literal: Bo Yi's descendants were enfeoffed as Qin during King Ping of Zhou's time. Xiang Yu extinguished them. There are basic annals that speak of this.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Yi's descendants were enfeoffed as Qin during the time of King Ping of Zhou. Xiang Yu destroyed them. Their story is told in the basic annals.

sentences.zh: 垂、益、夔、龍，其後不知所封，不見也。

translations.literal: Chui, Yi, Kui, and Long—their descendants are not known where they were enfeoffed and are not seen.
translations.idiomatic: Chui, Yi, Kui, and Long—it is not known where their descendants were enfeoffed, and they are not seen in the records.

sentences.zh: 右十一人者，皆唐虞之際名有功德臣也；

translations.literal: Right eleven people, all Tang Yu time famous meritorious virtue ministers;
translations.idiomatic: The eleven people above were all famous ministers with merit and virtue during the time of Tang and Yu;

sentences.zh: 其五人之後皆至帝王，餘乃為顯諸侯。

translations.literal: Their five people's descendants all became emperor kings, remainder became illustrious feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: The descendants of five of them all became emperors and kings, while the rest became prominent feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 滕、薛、騶，夏、殷、周之閒封也，小，不足齒列，弗論也。

translations.literal: Teng, Xue, and Zou were enfeoffed between Xia, Yin, and Zhou. They were small and insufficient to rank with the teeth. They are not discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Teng, Xue, and Zou were enfeoffed between Xia, Yin, and Zhou. They were small and too slight to rank among the others, so they are not discussed.

sentences.zh: 周武王時，侯伯尚千餘人。

translations.literal: During Zhou's King Wu's time, there were still over a thousand hou and bo.
translations.idiomatic: During the time of King Wu of Zhou, there were still over a thousand marquises and earls.

sentences.zh: 及幽、厲之後，諸侯力攻相并。

translations.literal: And after You and Li, the feudal lords attacked each other with force and annexed one another.
translations.idiomatic: After Kings You and Li, the feudal lords attacked one another by force and annexed one another’s lands.

sentences.zh: 江、黃、胡、沈之屬，不可勝數，故弗采著于傳（上）［云］。

translations.literal: Jiang, Huang, Hu, Shen and such, cannot exhaust count, therefore not collected recorded in transmissions (upper) [cloud].
translations.idiomatic: Jiang, Huang, Hu, Shen, and the like are too numerous to count exhaustively, so they are not collected and recorded in these traditions.

sentences.zh: 太史公曰：舜之德可謂至矣！

translations.literal: Grand Historian said: Shun virtue can be called utmost!
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Historian says: Shun's virtue can be called the utmost!

sentences.zh: 禪位於夏，而後世血食者歷三代。

translations.literal: He yielded the throne to Xia, and his later generations' blood sacrifices spanned three dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: He yielded the throne to Xia, yet his descendants continued to receive blood sacrifices through three dynasties.

sentences.zh: 及楚滅陳，而田常得政於齊，卒為建國，百世不絕，苗裔茲茲，有土者不乏焉。

translations.literal: And when Chu extinguished Chen, Tian Chang obtained government in Qi. He finally established a state that has not ended for a hundred generations. His descendants flourish and flourish. Those with land are not lacking.
translations.idiomatic: When Chu destroyed Chen, Tian Chang took power in Qi and ultimately founded a state whose line endured for a hundred generations. His descendants flourished, and many of them held land.

sentences.zh: 至禹，於周則杞，微甚，不足數也。

translations.literal: As for Yu, in Zhou it was Qi. It was extremely tiny and insufficient to count.
translations.idiomatic: As for Yu's line, under the Zhou it survived as Qi, but it was so diminished that it scarcely counted.

sentences.zh: 楚惠王滅杞，其後越王句踐興。

translations.literal: King Hui of Chu extinguished Qi. His descendants' King Gou Jian of Yue rose.
translations.idiomatic: King Hui of Chu destroyed Qi. Later, King Gou Jian of Yue rose.
